title: Italian-Style Pork Ramen
description: A fusion of Italian and Japanese flavors in a hearty pork ramen dish.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions. Reserve 2 cups of pasta water before draining.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the sliced onions to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are caramelized and golden brown, about 20 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the shoyu to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the pork shoulder to the pot and add enough chicken broth to cover the meat. Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the pork in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before shredding it into bite-sized pieces.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot with the onion and garlic mixture. Toss to combine, adding some reserved pasta water if the mixture seems dry.
Add the shredded pork to the pot and toss to combine.
Season the ramen with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Italian-Style Pork Ramen hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
